title: VTG New York Central Tender – Precision Miniatures – #5405 – HO Scale
descriptionText:
locomotive tender, marked #5405, made by Precision Miniatures (PMI) in HO scale. This tender features detailed trucks, metal wheels, molded coal load, brass-colored railings, and crisp “NEW YORK CENTRAL” lettering on both sides. Underside is stamped “PRECISION MINIATURES”, confirming the manufacturer.
This is an excellent piece for collectors, steam-era layouts, or anyone restoring a NYC locomotive set.
Item Details
Brand: Precision Miniatures (PMI)
Road Name: New York Central
Road Number: 5405
Scale: HO
Type: Steam Locomotive Tender
Features:
Molded coal load
Brass-tone handrails & ladder
Metal wheels
Detailed trucks
Front & rear couplers
